arrival.text: A robot with wheels! It looks stuck. I'll find out what happened.

scan.text: I'm Spirit. I reached Mars in 2004 to look for signs of ancient water in its rocks and soil.
My mission was planned to last ninety Martian days. I worked for more than six Earth years.
One of my wheels stopped working. My team found a way to keep me moving: driving backward and dragging that wheel.
It scraped the ground and uncovered material that helped scientists study places where water had once been.
Later, I got stuck in very soft soil. My team tried to get me out, but couldn't.
I kept making observations from where I was. When winter came, I lost contact with Earth.

wrap_up.text: Your story's in my log now. Let's see who else is out here.

reaction.text: Even the broken wheel helped make a discovery. I'm glad I found you, Spirit.
